hot_themes: Extreme overthinking and social anxiety spiraling
Turning passions into paid chores (Overjustification effect)
Emotional control and stoic silence under pressure
hook_patterns: One friend catches the other spiraling over a mundane social interaction
A direct 'Why doing X is secretly ruining your life' interrupted by comedic banter
Roleplaying a toxic scenario (bad boss, bully, client) with absurdly exaggerated reactions

ideas_for_us.hook: Friend A starts aggressively charging Friend B 50 cents per advice session, only to instantly hate giving advice.
ideas_for_us.psychology_focus: Explaining how external rewards kill intrinsic motivation when turning a hobby into a job.

ideas_for_us.hook: Friend A refuses to enter a room because of a tiny mustard stain, convinced everyone is judging their entire bloodline.
ideas_for_us.psychology_focus: Illustrating how people vastly overestimate how much others notice their flaws or actions.

ideas_for_us.hook: Friend A tries working 1000% harder at a fast-food counter to get promoted, while Friend B explains the 'Effort Paradox'.
ideas_for_us.psychology_focus: Why being overly available leads to being undervalued, and how strategic boundaries increase perceived worth.

ideas_for_us.hook: Friend B accidentally agrees to move Friend A's 400-pound sofa at 3 AM just to avoid saying the word 'no'.
ideas_for_us.psychology_focus: Exploring the 'fawn' trauma response and the psychology of people-pleasing as an anxiety defense mechanism.
